targets.title: Meta-analysis of correlation coefﬁcients: A Monte Carlo comparison of ﬁxed- and random-effects models.
targets.evidence_quote: The present attempt to replicate Field’s simulations included comparisons with analytic values as well as results for efﬁciency and conﬁdence-interval coverage.
targets.outcome_quote: Field’s results under homogeneity were mostly replicable, but those under heterogeneity were not: The latter exhibited up to over .17 more bias than ours and, for tests of the mean correlation and homogeneity, respectively, nonnull rejection rates up to .60 lower and .65 higher.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Fresh Monte Carlo samples re-test two published simulation studies; authors explicitly distinguish replicable homogeneous results from nonreplicable heterogeneous results.
